task_message:
Case M16: segment the myxoid soft-tissue tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 400x400x270 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
Case M16 is complete. 

**Summary:**
- **Lesion identified:** a well-circumscribed, markedly T2-hyperintense (myxoid) soft-tissue mass in the right gluteal/ischiofemoral region, at the level of the right hip/proximal thigh — the only discrete soft-tissue tumor in the volume (asymmetric relative to the left side).
- **Excluded:** the large midline T2-bright pelvic structure, which is the urinary bladder (typical location, thin wall, homogeneous fluid signal, continuity with the urethra in the male pelvis).
- **Segmentation:** single connected component, 48.6 mL, extent axial 53–108, coronal 136–180, sagittal 280–326 (≈5.5 × 4.5 × 4.6 cm).
- **Verification:** contour checked against the lesion boundary in zoomed axial, coronal and sagittal planes; past-the-end slices (axial 45/116, coronal 128/188) show no residual lesion; no candidate corrections were proposed; small superior bright spurs were judged to be vessels and correctly left out.
- **Final confidence:** high.
